notes: Seed set built from the FY2025-26 corpus. Every reference figure was found in the indexed chunk text (see 'verification'). must_include: every inner list must be matched by at least one of its strings (case-insensitive; commas, spaces and currency signs ignored). relevant_pages: pages known to contain the answer; any one of them counts as a hit. Split: stratified by answer group (numeric / text / decline), ~60% dev / 40% test, seed 20261030, fixed before any run. Error analysis uses the dev split only; the test split is for reporting.
